services.name: Calm Water Cruise
services.desc: The Colorado River enters a vast sandstone wilderness as it flows south out of the Moab valley. Here the river has no rapids but runs slow and easy deep within majestic canyons. This beautiful and peaceful section of Canyonlands is named Meander Canyon. Traveling by rigid hull inflatable boat (RHIB) makes this personal tour on the Colorado River a favorite by many of our guests. Explore the natural beauty of the Colorado on our half-day motorized scenic tour. Unravel the geology of the area beneath two thousand foot canyon walls. We travel in small groups along calm waters. services.name: Horse Canyon
services.desc: Deep within Horseshoe Canyon, a detached unit of Canyonlands National Park, lies a mysterious archeological site. We travel from Moab, Utah across the Green River Desert to this remote canyon. A wonderful hike leads us to elaborate life sized rock art panels, considered the finest in North America. The 4X4 road to Horseshoe Canyon is beautifully isolated. The deep red Carmel sandstone caps a thousand feet of Navajo slickrock. We go into the heart of Robbers Roost Country, where Butch Cassidy learned to cattle rustle. This is one of the most remote wilderness areas left in America. blurb: Guests can join half-day, one-day, or multi-day white water rafting trips down the Colorado River. They also offer 4-wheel drive vehicle tours to backcountry locations with hikes to ancestral puebloan dwelling sites. Combination land and river trips range from one to seven days, with options for rowing raft, paddle raft, whitewater RHIB, and inflatable kayaks by request.
